verdict.rationale: Datalab documents an OpenAPI 3.1.0 document titled "Datalab API" at www.datalab.to/openapi.json, advertised in its llms.txt under an "OpenAPI Specs" heading, which delivers a downloadable machine-readable spec. The probe's 404s covered only documentation-subdomain paths, not the main-domain URL, so they do not contradict this. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the main-domain spec URL resolves and is complete.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Datalab serves its OpenAPI 3.1.0 document (info title "Datalab API") from its main domain, advertised in the docs llms.txt under an "## OpenAPI Specs" heading
